business_problem: Fortal Studio needed to scale 15-40 episode vertical dramas without the cost, staffing burden, continuity problems, Thai-localization gaps, and broken handoffs that came from conventional live-action production and disconnected AI tools.
solution_summary: Fortal Studio used BytePlus to replace a fragmented set of creative tools with an end-to-end AI production backbone for vertical short dramas. Scripts and shot breakdowns begin the workflow, then Dola Seedream 5.0 creates recurring character references, key art, and poster frames that become locked reference sets for the rest of production. Dreamina Seedance 2.0 uses those references to generate series-ready shots while maintaining character appearance, wardrobe, and set continuity across hundreds of clips and supporting segments up to 1080p and 15 seconds. Dola Seed Audio adds Thai-language dialogue and voice performance, and Video on Demand (VOD) provides encoding and distribution for finished episodes. Because assets stay tied to the same references across image, video, and audio stages, Fortal can regenerate revisions instead of rebuilding productions from scratch, making episodic output more reproducible for its own slate and partner work.

data_flow: Fortal starts with script and shot breakdowns, locks character references in Dola Seedream 5.0, generates episode clips in Dreamina Seedance 2.0, adds Thai-language voices with Dola Seed Audio, and then uses VOD to encode and distribute the finished short-drama output.
business_outcome: Fortal Studio proved a scalable AI short-drama pipeline that drove more than one million Facebook views, cut revision cycles from another production day to hours, enabled evidence-led pilot testing, and turned its internal workflow into a partner-facing commercial offering.
